issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Summary

Implement a unified Advanced Settings Modal and Preset Management System for the One-Click Batch Processing Pipeline (Enfuse -> Stitch -> AI Nadir -> Auto Level).

Key Capabilities

  • Advanced Settings Modal: Accessible via the Advanced Settings button in the batch setup sidebar.
  • Built-in & Custom Presets: Support for 4 immutable default presets (Real Estate HDR 8K, Fast Draft 4K, Lossless Archival 12K, Outdoor Single-Shot) and local custom user presets.
  • Dirty State Tracking: Dynamic (Modified) indicator on preset parameter divergence with Save / Save As New workflows.
  • Import / Export: JSON-based preset export and import with zero secret leak (API keys excluded, paths sanitized).
  • Reactive Conflict Bridge: Visual warning badges and automatic handling for format bridging (e.g., Stitching TIFF -> AI Nadir JPG conversion).
  • Interactive Prototype: Interactive UI mockup delivered at docs/prototype/batch-pipeline-advanced-settings-modal.html.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Technical Architecture & ADR-0004 recorded (docs/design/adr-batch-pipeline-presets.md)
  • Full specification documented in Obsidian Vault
  • Interactive HTML/JS prototype built & verified
  • TypeScript types & Zod schema validation in src/types/batchPipeline.ts
  • Frontend UI component integration (AdvancedSettingsModal & Sidebar Quick Selector)
  • Local AppData persistence layer for custom presets ($APPDATA/gothru-photo-studio/presets/)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

  • Root Cause / Background: Batch processing across multiple engines (Enfuse, Fisheye Stitch, AI Nadir, Auto Level) required a unified configuration surface and customizable parameter presets without polluting individual pipeline runs with machine-specific credentials or temporary paths.
  • Changes Made & Verified:
    • src/types/batchPipeline.ts: Added strongly-typed definitions for BatchPipelinePresetConfig and BatchPipelinePreset.
    • src/renderer/components/features/Edit/BatchPipeline/modals/AdvancedSettingsModal.tsx: Built multi-tab modal (enfuse, stitching, nadir, autoLevel) with dirty indicators and parameter controls.
    • src/renderer/components/features/Edit/BatchPipeline/components/PresetBar.tsx: Added preset selector, quick reset button, and preset deletion confirmation modal.
    • src/renderer/components/features/Edit/BatchPipeline/hooks/usePresets.ts & utils/presets.ts: Implemented preset persistence via IPC settings, dirty key calculation (changedPresetKeys), and preset cloning.
    • Reactive conflict validation verified for AI Nadir with TIFF output formats.
